note: Landmark runtime LOD candidates, pinned for game-camera review; the shipped game-ready tiers stay pinned in docs/astro-assets.lock.json. Plain GLB is the author's source of truth, so the plain files are pinned and the build packs them. D0 only: nothing in the game uses D1-D3 yet, and pinning them would add release weight for no reader. Budgets are read from the author's manifest-lods.json pinned here, which is listed first so a fetch verifies it before any tier is measured against it. HUGIN is held back at this revision: its LOD1 and LOD2 keep the REUSABLE_BOOSTER node but merge the booster's geometry into consolidated static meshes (21.9% and 24.5% of their triangles sit in the booster's box, against 1.6% of the shipped model once the booster is removed), so base-layout's hide can no longer remove it — a break of the hideable-part rule in docs/ASSET-COLLABORATION.md, raised with the owner.
